## Edit this guide {#edit-source}

Edit [the main guide](_guide.md){data-source-link="true"} for project and usage documentation
or [the functional reference](_reference.md){data-source-link="true"} for implementation routes.
Run the following from `documentation/collection-guide`.

```sh
quarto render --no-execute
```

The command creates `site/report.html`. In an editable collection copy,
place that generated file beside `report.qmd` before opening it so its
relative links resolve. The public HTML build does this automatically.
The [documentation index](../README.md) links the editable examples.
